title: Onboarding
subtitle: First-run wizard — three doors, GitHub first · sign in, open or create a shared project, land in the canvas browser · zero terminal, under two minutes
brief: Phase 29 (native collab app, epic E4). On first launch (no last project remembered) Maude shows this instead of the canvas browser. Three doors, GitHub first: (A) Continue with GitHub — the headline door; (B) Open a folder on this computer; (C) Connect to a team hub (advanced, collapsed). The bar: a complete first-timer is guided into a working project in under two minutes. Lifts the Studio Hub artboard-B wizard skeleton (left rail + main card + next-step peek) but DEMOTES the hub bootstrap-key claim to the advanced door — GitHub is the headline. Vocabulary stays plain throughout. Success state previews the Save -> Publish -> Pull cycle the collab tour teaches.

artboards.label: A · Welcome — three doors, GitHub first
artboards.note: Full-window wizard: calm left rail (brand + value prop + three reassurances) + main column with the door picker. GitHub is the headline door (accent ring + Sign in with GitHub CTA); Open a folder is the quiet secondary; Connect to a team hub is one advanced, dashed line. No terminal mentioned anywhere.

artboards.label: B · GitHub door — open a shared project or start new
artboards.note: After sign-in (rail shows 'Signed in as @octocat'): a Start-a-new-project card on top, then a 'Shared with you' list of projects to open. Private/public lock-globe icon, owner + updated meta, Open affordance per row.

artboards.label: C · Local folder — drag-drop or choose
artboards.note: Big dashed drag-drop zone (folder glyph + 'Drag a project folder here' + 'Choose a folder…') and an info callout: not a Maude project yet -> we'll offer to set one up, nothing changes until you say so.

artboards.label: D · Team hub (advanced) — address + invite link
artboards.note: Advanced door: Hub address + Invite link fields (mono inputs with leading glyphs) + Connect, then a success callout (connected, syncing). Reassures that most people use GitHub.

artboards.label: E · You're in — the Save -> Publish -> Pull cycle
artboards.note: Success state: green check badge, 'You're in.', project name, and the cycle preview panel — a 'Together · automatic, no buttons' live-layer pill floating over the Save changes locally -> Publish for everyone -> Pull changes row. CTA: Take the 60-second tour / Skip. This previews the collab infographic the tour renders.
